text: Push, pull, legs. The most famous split on the internet. But should you do it?
Push day: chest, shoulders, triceps. Pull day: back and biceps. Leg day: legs and glutes.
Run it three days a week, and each muscle gets hit once. Run it six days, and it's twice.
Six days is great if you can recover. On three days, make each session count.
Next up: the bro split. Save this.
